activities.text: Ran the schedule audit before dawn — Torts on Zoom from home, Contracts makeup at PACI, no conflicts to fix

Torts on Zoom from home, 9 to noon — strict liability and vicarious liability, exam format landed mid-class
Lunch gap — bread and butter, dinner check-in with no plan yet and dumplings quietly winning
Out the door to PACI for the Contracts makeup class, 1:30 to 3 — textbook in the bag
Back home for a printer test — page came out clean, black reading 100%, colours in the 80s

Out to Adam's for Mario Kart with Colten
